title: Police Services (Broward Sheriff's Office)
key_finding: North Lauderdale's official city site says Broward Sheriff's Office provides law-enforcement services for the city and lists a city police-services department page centered on BSO service.

title: FY 2026 Adopted Budget with Links
key_finding: The FY2026 adopted budget says the city currently contracts with Broward Sheriff's Office to provide police service, shows a North Lauderdale police department organizational chart contractually provided by BSO, and publishes FY2024 actual citywide public-safety metrics including 798 crimes reported and 32,661 calls for service.

title: Broward Sheriff's Office North Lauderdale district page
key_finding: BSO's current North Lauderdale district page says BSO provides law-enforcement services for the City of North Lauderdale, lists a dedicated district office at 701 SW 71 Avenue, and states the district has 68 employees including 61 sworn personnel.

title: Agreement for Police Services
publisher: Broward Sheriff's Office / City of North Lauderdale
key_finding: The executed 2017 police-services agreement says North Lauderdale wished to maintain its charter police power while providing daily police services through contractual agreement with BSO, sets the term through September 30, 2021 with a renewal option, and specifies a city-specific staffing structure and minimum staffing.

title: FDLE ATMS agency registry search surface
key_finding: FDLE's current ATMS registry list still includes North Lauderdale Public Safety Department with ORI FL0062300, preserving an official state agency identity for the city.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2020A
key_finding: FDLE's 2020 county-and-municipal offense report lists North Lauderdale Police Department with population 45,549 and total index crime 838.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2021A
key_finding: FDLE's 2021 county-and-municipal offense report retains North Lauderdale Police Department as a named Broward municipal row with population 44,855 but blanks all offense fields.

title: FIBRS Offense Detail 2021-2025 Q3 workbook repo copy
publisher: Florida Department of Law Enforcement / CrimeRisk repo copy
key_finding: Inspection of the repo's official FDLE FIBRS workbook copy found no North Lauderdale or FL0062300 row in the 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, or 2025 Q3 offense sheets.

title: FBI CDE Florida roster raw file 2024
publisher: Federal Bureau of Investigation / CrimeRisk repo copy
key_finding: The official 2024 FBI CDE Florida roster still lists North Lauderdale Police Department, ORI FL0062300, as a City agency in Broward County with is_nibrs false and no nibrs_start_date.

title: agency_to_jurisdiction_crosswalk.parquet
key_finding: The live crosswalk routes FL0062300 exclusively to 12:municipal:place:1249425.

title: agency_master.parquet
key_finding: FL0062300 remains classified as a local police agency with SRS and NIBRS source-presence flags through 2024 even though no usable public post-2020 observation row is recovered.

title: agency_year_observations.parquet
key_finding: Repo observations show FL0062300 with annual Part I totals of 1,051 in 2018, 1,047 in 2019, and 838 in 2020, followed by zero-valued annual placeholders in 2021-2024 and no recovered NIBRS rows.
